canonicalLegalEntityId.description: Canonical legal-entity identifier known to Control Plane. First-party IDs reconcile to contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml; external IDs are Control-Plane-issued or registered and need not appear in that registry (ADR-BCP-018).

legacyLegalEntityAlias.description: Legacy control-plane alias accepted at documented input boundaries during the v1 compatibility window only.

legalEntityIdInput.description: Compatibility input union. Consumers must resolve aliases and emit only canonicalLegalEntityId values.

legalEntityId.description: Backward-compatible definition name for canonical legal-entity output and persistence contracts.

tenantId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted tenant identifier. It must not contain a legal-entity, country, market or vendor identity.

productId.description: Version-1 product identifier. Canonical engine products use kebab case; underscore aliases remain accepted during migration.

engineId.description: A registered engine: the service that owns a capability provider, named as its repository, e.g. baobab-trade. Distinct from capability/v1 engineKey, the technology family (e.g. medusa), which an ExternalReference names as its system_namespace (ADR-SHARED-012).

engineInstanceId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of a concrete engine deployment. The single grammar for engine_instance_id in every contract (ADR-SHARED-012).

engineInstanceStatus.description: An engine instance's lifecycle status. Only an ACTIVE instance is eligible for capability resolution; RETIRED is terminal.

engineReleaseId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of an immutable EngineRelease (ADR-BCP-025 section 2.1, topology/v1 release.schema.json).

deploymentObservationId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of one accepted DeploymentObservation (ADR-BCP-025 section 2.6, topology/v1 deployment-observation.schema.json).

mappingId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque mapping identifier. Not derived from canonical identity or external reference.

canonicalEntityId.description: Opaque canonical identifier for a business concept minted by its authoritative domain.

externalReferenceId.description: Control Plane reference to a native identifier from an external system.

mappingScopeId.description: Identifier for a mapping scope (combination of dimensions).

mappingType.description: Semantic classification of the mapping relationship.

mappingDirection.description: Direction of resolution for the mapping.

mappingConfidence.description: Confidence level for imported or reconciled mappings.

tenantProvisioningId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a TenantProvisioning orchestration aggregate (Technical Specification SS21). Distinct from tenantId: a tenant has exactly one lifecycle identity but may have more than one provisioning run over time (initial onboarding, later product additions).

tenantProvisioningPhase.description: Deprecated (ADR-SHARED-015): the orchestration phases of Technical Specification SS22 without the terminal states. Use tenantProvisioningState, the canonical TenantProvisioning lifecycle.

tenantProvisioningState.description: The canonical TenantProvisioning lifecycle (Technical Specification SS22, ADR-SHARED-015; transitions in tenant-provisioning-lifecycle.yaml). BLOCKED is a known, remediable condition; FAILED an operational failure; REMEDIATING the deliberate resolution of known blockers. Distinct from ExecutionOperation status and readiness status.

provisioningPlanId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of an immutable plan (a ChangePlan, ADR-BCP-021 SS21).

changesetId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of a Changeset (ADR-BCP-021 section 7).

providerMigrationId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of a ProviderMigration (ADR-BCP-006 section 119).

approvalDecisionId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of an ApprovalDecision (ADR-BCP-021 SS50).

operationId.description: Control Plane-minted identifier of a durable ExecutionOperation (ADR-BCP-022 SS58).

marketParticipationCapability.description: What a tenant may do in a market (ADR-BCP-011 section 6). A governed vocabulary: extended only through controlled registry evolution, never with arbitrary strings.

planDigest.description: Digest of a plan's material execution semantics (ADR-BCP-021 SS23). An approval binds to it; any material change produces another digest.

readinessSnapshotId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ReadinessSnapshot (Technical Specification SS44, SS51).

readinessStatus.description: Readiness verdict for one object in the readiness hierarchy (Provider/Capability/Product/Estate/Tenant, Technical Specification SS44). UNKNOWN until readiness has been evaluated.

driftRecordId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a Drift record (Technical Specification SS42-43).

driftObjectType.description: The class of object a Drift record compares desired vs. observed state for. Intentionally the set of objects Programme Gate P0's classification (phase-0-architecture-inventory-and-lock.md) identified as carrying desired/observed state, not an open-ended free-text field. ENGINE_INSTANCE_RELEASE (ADR-BCP-025 section 2.7) compares an engine instance's desired release with the release it is observed running; its object_reference is the engine_instance_id, its reason_code a topology/v1 releaseDriftReason, and it is recorded for each tenant bound to the instance (ADR-BCP-006 section 67 reverse impact).

driftResolution.description: Whether a detected drift has been reconciled, remains unresolved, or reconciliation itself is blocked (e.g. reconciling it safely requires human approval).
